title: Community, Lemi Orhan Ergin
description: Software Craftsmanship Turkey, Agile Turkey, and the manifestos Lemi Orhan Ergin translated into Turkish.

blocks.text: Communities I have built or helped run, and manifestos I have translated into Turkish.

items.title: Software Craftsmanship Turkey
items.text: A community for developers who care about their craft. More than 200 free meetups so far, and code retreats, including the Global Day of Coderetreat, which I have facilitated since 2013.

items.title: Agile Turkey
items.text: More than 50 free public meetups (Agile Buluşmalar) in two years. Product owner and organization lead of Agile Turkey Summit 2015 and 2016 and CraftSummit 2015.

items.title: Manifesto translations
items.text: Part of the team that translated the [Agile Manifesto](https://agilemanifesto.org/iso/tr/manifesto.html). Turkish translator of the [Software Craftsmanship Manifesto](https://manifesto.softwarecraftsmanship.org/#/tr), the [SOA Manifesto](http://www.soa-manifesto.org/default_turkish.html) and the Disciplined Agile Manifesto.
